title: Capture and refund a Stripe payment
caption: Mirrors tools/e2e/specs/ota-admin/payments.e2e.ts (nightly, Stripe test mode). Needs the OTA's Stripe test connection and bash tools/dev/stripe-listen.sh --only ota.

steps.title: Hold bookings for staff
steps.body: Set **Ticketing policy** to Manual review and save.

steps.title: Book with a test card
steps.body: Book on the OTA's storefront with `4242 4242 4242 4242`.
steps.expect: Booking confirmed in manual review; payment `authorized`; PaymentIntent `requires_capture`.

steps.title: Capture
steps.body: Open the payment, **Capture**, reason, leave the amount empty.
steps.expect: `captured`; `payment.capture` staff action; **Refresh from Stripe** shows PaymentIntent `succeeded`.

steps.title: Refund part
steps.expect: A `refunds` row `pending` → `succeeded` after the webhook; payment `partially_refunded`; `payment.refund` staff action.

steps.title: Refusals
steps.body: As an agent, open the same payment.
steps.expect: Capture offered, no Refund button (no `payments:refund`); an airline-card payment shows "Refunded by the airline" for every role.
